title: Meta-Rational Pragmatics · Why read this book?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: How do we reason when no fixed system fits the situation?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This research course examines understanding as the learning of executable distinctions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It connects representation, interpretation, uncertainty, and action within an operational architecture.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Mathematical chapters introduce equivalence, sufficient states, predictive models, and abstract interpretation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Examples study counterexamples, refinement, information loss, and the diagnosis of errors.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The programme includes applications and proposed experiments for testing its claims.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its central question concerns which distinctions an agent must preserve to act competently.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This invitation is for readers seeking wiser action amid ambiguity and changing contexts.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read Meta-Rational Pragmatics to follow the complete argument, examples, and consequences.
